verdict.rationale: A runtime probe found a publicly served OpenAPI 3.1 spec whose routes carry a /v1/ version prefix (e.g. /v1/auth/*, /v1/users/*), so some API versioning exists. However, nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, and the probe notes there is no developer program or public API keys around the spec, so this looks like an internal app/bridge API rather than a supported public interface. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, versioning/stability guarantees, public developer API program, changelog or sunset timelines.
